m: The chocolate truffle cake was the star of my mum's birthday. Moist, rich and not too sweet, everyone asked where it was from!
Their croissants are the real deal: flaky, buttery and baked fresh every morning. My weekend ritual now.
Lovely café and warm staff. The vegan apple pie surprised me, so good. I wish they opened on Sundays.
Got the family pie bundle for Monday lunch. The apple pie was gone in minutes, really wished they had more of it.
